# contextforge_server (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a ContextForge server by ID



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Server ID for lookup

### Read-Only

- `associated_a2a_agents` (List of String) Associated A2A agent IDs
- `associated_prompts` (List of String) Associated prompt IDs
- `associated_resources` (List of String) Associated resource IDs
- `associated_tools` (List of String) Associated tool IDs
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `created_by` (String) User who created the server (read-only metadata)
- `created_from_ip` (String) IP address of creator (read-only metadata)
- `created_user_agent` (String) User agent of creator (read-only metadata)
- `created_via` (String) Creation method (read-only metadata)
- `description` (String) Server description
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is enabled
- `federation_source` (String) Federation source (read-only metadata)
- `icon` (String) Server icon (URL or data URI)
- `import_batch_id` (String) Import batch identifier (read-only metadata)
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the server is active
- `metrics` (Attributes) Server performance metrics (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))
- `modified_by` (String) User who last modified the server (read-only metadata)
- `modified_from_ip` (String) IP address of last modifier (read-only metadata)
- `modified_user_agent` (String) User agent of last modifier (read-only metadata)
- `modified_via` (String) Modification method (read-only metadata)
- `name` (String) Server name
- `oauth_config` (Dynamic, Sensitive) OAuth configuration metadata
- `oauth_enabled` (Boolean) Whether OAuth is enabled for this server
- `owner_email` (String) Owner email address
- `tags` (List of String) Server tags
- `team` (String) Team name
- `team_id` (String) Team ID
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `version` (Number) Version number (read-only metadata)
- `visibility` (String) Visibility setting (public, private, etc.)

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Read-Only:

- `avg_response_time` (Number) Average response time in milliseconds
- `failed_executions` (Number) Number of failed executions
- `failure_rate` (Number) Failure rate (0.0 to 1.0)
- `last_execution_time` (String) Last execution timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `max_response_time` (Number) Maximum response time in milliseconds
- `min_response_time` (Number) Minimum response time in milliseconds
- `successful_executions` (Number) Number of successful executions
- `total_executions` (Number) Total number of executions
